stem: Which graph represents y as a function of x?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with y = 1, a horizontal line

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with a curved arrow going from bottom left to top right

options.label: C
options.text: Graph of a circle centered at the origin

options.label: D
options.text: Graph of a vertical line at x = 2

visual_elements: Graph A: horizontal line y=1 on coordinate plane with x from -4 to 4 and y from -4 to 4
Graph B: curve starting near (-3,-4) going up in an s-shape to near (3,4)
Graph C: circle centered at (0,0) with radius 3 on the coordinate plane
Graph D: vertical line at x=2 on the coordinate plane
